title: 熱力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Thermodynamics II
teachers:
FUKUE Takashi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
keywords: Vapor power cycles, Refrigeration cycles and Air Conditioning
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn basic knowledge of the irreversibility in the nature world
(2) Learn how to convert energy and obtain work from heat
(3) Acquire design skills for energy conversion in mechanical engineering
advice:
This is an advanced course in thermodynamics that follows Thermodynamics I.
We will cover the following topics:

1. Carnot cycle
2. The 2nd law of thermodynamics
3. Entropy, Exergy
4. Thermal characteristics of real gas
5. Vapor power cycles, Refrigeration cycles and Air Conditioning

Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to solve exercises independently.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.

Detailed schedules and content of the course are explained in the first class.
books:
Textbooks : (1) JSME Text Series, Thermodynamics (Maruzen)
Reference book : (1) Arai, Furuhata, English-Japanese Bilingual Textbook Series, Thermodynamics, Morikita (2) JSME Text Series, Problems in Thermodynamics (Maruzen)
Reserved books : N/A
requiredKnowledge:
Have sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential and integral calculations).
Know how to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the Carnot cycle and apply it to problems
Be able to explain the 2nd law of thermodynamics and apply it to problems
Be able to explain entropy and apply it to problems
Be able to explain the characteristics of a real gas with phase change and apply it to problems
Be able to explain vapor power and refrigeration cycles, and apply the knowledge to probrems

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain the 2nd law of thermodynamics. Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems related to thermal issues.
(2) Explain Carnot cycle. Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems related to thermal issues.
(3) Explain a real gas and its characteristics. Also, use this understanding to solve advanced problems related to thermal issues.
(4) Explain various vapor power cycles, refrigeration cycles and air conditioning. Also, evaluate the performance of thermal systems.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain the 2nd law of thermodynamics. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems related to thermal issues.
(2) Explain Carnot cycle. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems related to thermal issues.
(3) Explain a real gas and its characteristics. Also, use this understanding to solve basic problems related to thermal issues.
(4) Explain the basics of various vapor power cycles, refrigeration cycles, and air conditioning. Also, calculate the performance of basic thermal systems.
